floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.source: Concrete, lined floors and existing tiles need different checks before floor tile installation. We assess accessible condition, flatness, movement, moisture and adhesion risks. Old finishes may need removal, and damage exposed underneath may change the preparation. Tiling over existing tiles is conditional on a suitable base and compatible installation system.
floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.target: 混凝土、板材地面及现有瓷砖需不同检查。我们评估可接触状况、平整度、位移、潮湿及粘结风险。可能需拆旧饰面，暴露的损伤也可能改变准备范围。覆盖旧砖须有合适基层及兼容安装系统。

floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.source: In a laundry, investigate water damage before covering it. New tiles do not repair a failed waterproofing layer or a plumbing leak. Coordinate any required
floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.target: 洗衣房受水损坏应先调查，不能直接覆盖。新砖不能修复失效防水层或管道漏水。安装前协调所需

floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.source: and relevant trade work before installation.
Floor tile height transitions and clearances

We check the full floor build-up: tiles, adhesive and base preparation. We plan doorway transitions, door clearances and joins to carpet or timber before laying, so the finished height works with the way you use the rooms.
floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.target: 我们核对瓷砖、胶层和基层处理组成的完整地面厚度。铺砖前规划门口过渡、门扇净空及地毯或木地板交接，让完成面高度适合房间通行。

floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.source: In kitchens and laundries, we check retained appliances, cabinet plinths and thresholds before work. A higher floor can affect dishwasher removal and appliance clearance. We define the tile edges and joints around fixed cabinetry and identify any cabinet movement or service disconnection as a separate scope.
floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.target: 厨房与洗衣房施工前，我们检查保留设备、柜底踢脚及门槛。地面升高可能影响洗碗机拆出和设备净空。围绕固定柜明确瓷砖边缘及接缝做法，移柜或断开管线单独列明范围。

floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.source: We plan grout lines and cuts across kitchens, living areas and connecting hallways together. Room dimensions, out-of-square walls, doorways and tile patterns guide the set-out. We agree the main sightlines and visible cuts with you before installation.
floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.target: 厨房、起居室与相连走廊的砖缝和切砖由我们整体规划。结合房间尺寸、不方正墙面、门口及铺法安排排版，安装前与您确认主要视线和可见切砖。

floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.source: Large-format tiles need a carefully prepared base. We check flatness, arrange the necessary levelling and plan support beneath the tiles to achieve consistent adjoining edges and a balanced layout.
floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.target: 大规格瓷砖需要细致处理基层。我们检查平整度、安排必要找平并规划砖下支撑，让相邻砖边与整体排布协调。

floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.source: We help you consider tile size, thickness, floor-use specifications and cleaning alongside appearance. Our installation materials are selected to work with your tiles, base and any membrane. Share your preferred tiles before purchase so we can plan the finish together.
floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.target: 选砖时，我们帮您一起考虑外观、规格、厚度、地面使用要求与清洁。安装材料与瓷砖、基层及防水层相匹配。购买前即可把喜欢的砖发给我们，一起规划完成效果。

floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.source: Kitchen, laundry and living floors often sit on essential access routes. Discuss which rooms must remain usable, where furniture and appliances will go, and whether the work can be divided into suitable stages. Phasing may affect layout, work boundaries and the programme; a walkway cannot be promised through an area that needs protection while curing.
floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.target: 厨房、洗衣房和起居室地面常处于重要通行路线。沟通哪些房间必须可用、家具设备放哪里，以及是否可分阶段施工。分期会影响排布、边界和工期；需保护养护的区域无法承诺持续通行。

floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.source: Return to foot traffic, furniture loads and normal cleaning may occur at different stages. Follow the confirmed instructions for the installed materials and conditions, rather than testing readiness by walking on the floor. Read the
floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.target: 可踩踏、放置家具和正常清洁可能在不同阶段恢复。遵循所用材料及现场条件的确认说明，不用踩踏来测试就绪。请参阅

floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.target: 大规格瓷质地砖与陶瓷地砖铺装

floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.source: We install porcelain and ceramic floor tiles in living rooms, kitchens, laundries and entryways. For large-format layouts, we check floor flatness, tile variation and the set-out before fixing. The aim is a consistent joint pattern, well-supported tiles and considered transitions at doorways and adjoining timber or carpet. Tile levelling clips help position tiles during installation; they do not replace preparing the base.
floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.target: 我们为客厅、厨房、洗衣房与玄关铺设瓷质及陶瓷地砖。大规格排版先核对地面平整度、砖材差异和起铺线，再进行铺装，做好对缝、粘结承托及与木地板或地毯的门口衔接。瓷砖找平卡用于施工定位，不能代替基层处理。

floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.source: Polished porcelain, glazed porcelain and full-body porcelain describe different product features. Rectified edges describe the edge treatment, not a zero-grout installation. We plan joint width and movement joints using the selected tile and installation system. Tell us the tile dimensions, finish and rooms involved to discuss tile removal, floor preparation and the finished floor height together.
floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.target: 抛光瓷质砖、釉面瓷质砖与通体瓷质砖描述的是不同产品特征。Rectified 指修边处理，不等于可以无缝铺贴。我们依据所选砖材与铺装系统安排缝宽和活动缝。说明砖规格、表面处理及房间范围，即可一起讨论拆砖、地面处理与完成面高度。

floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.source: Discuss your tile materials and installation →
Floor tile body, surface finish and cleaning needs
floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.target: 地砖砖体、表面处理与清洁需求

floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.source: For connected rooms, we compare porcelain and floor-rated ceramic products for the intended traffic, cleaning and wet entrances. Porcelain, polished, glazed and rectified describe different features. A polished surface or marble-look pattern is not a separate material, and a rectified edge still needs a planned grout joint.
floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.target: 相连房间选砖时，我们按通行、清洁及入口受潮情况，比较瓷质砖与明确适用于地面的陶瓷砖。瓷质、抛光、釉面和精修边描述不同特征。抛光表面或仿大理石花色并不是另一种材质，精修边也仍需规划砖缝。

floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.source: We check product thickness, format and the required preparation against door clearances and adjoining finishes. Natural stone, real terrazzo and cement tiles have their own fixing and care requirements; a look-alike porcelain tile should not inherit their material label. Product details help us define the base, adhesive, joints and any specified sealing in the written scope.
floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.target: 我们结合门口净空与相邻饰面，核对产品厚度、规格和所需基层处理。天然石材、真正水磨石和水泥砖各有相应粘贴与养护要求，仿其外观的瓷质砖不能沿用这些材质名称。提供产品资料，有助于在书面范围中明确基层、瓷砖胶、接缝及产品规定的封护处理。

floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.target: 比较瓷砖材质、表面与使用位置 →

floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.target: 沟通基层准备、高度过渡与地砖安装

floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.source: Tell us which rooms connect and whether the home will remain occupied. If you have selected or bought tiles, share the product details and available quantity so we can check them against the layout. We assess the base, transitions and access before confirming preparation and installation in writing; photos and measurements are optional.
floor-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[.target: 请说明哪些房间连通，以及施工期间是否仍居住。如已选购瓷砖，可提供产品资料和数量，我们会结合排布核对。我们评估基层、过渡和通行，再书面确认准备与安装；照片和尺寸为选填。
